First, count the number of distinct points in the path:  
M 60.00,77.00  
L 75.00,55.00  
L 6.00,60.00  
L 22.00,78.00  
L 3.00,96.00  
L 93.00,90.00  
L 60.00,77.00 (closes back to start)  

That’s 7 distinct vertices (the first and last are the same point, so it’s a closed shape with 7 sides).  

A 7-sided polygon is a heptagon.  

Final answer: (B)
